nodes.label: README
nodes.summary: Subscription Management API documentation: vertical slice architecture on .NET 10, Native AOT, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes platform with kind/Kong/Helm/Argo CD, all endpoints, configuration, testing, performance data, and deployment instructions.

nodes.label: ADR-001: Native AOT
nodes.summary: Decision to use Minimal APIs with CreateSlimBuilder, source-generated JSON, PublishAot=true, and analyzers as errors. No global warning suppression accepted.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Npgsql + SQL
nodes.summary: Decision to replace EF Core with NpgsqlDataSource + explicit SQL, per-aggregate stores (SubscriptionStore, PlanStore, InvoiceStore), pessimistic row locks, and domain classes unit-testable without a DB.

nodes.label: ADR-003: SQL Migrations
nodes.summary: Decision to use a separate migrator executable embedding versioned SQL (V1-V4), advisory locks, checksum verification, and running as a one-shot init container in Kubernetes.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Validation + Problem Details
nodes.summary: Decision to replace FluentValidation with hand-written validators returning Dictionary<string,string[]>, ApiProblemException, single IExceptionHandler, and RFC 9457 problem+json serialization through source-generated context.

nodes.label: .NET 10 Compatibility
nodes.summary: Package audit showing EF Core removed (AOT experimental), FluentValidation removed (AOT-unsafe), replacement packages (Npgsql, Redis, OpenTelemetry, OpenApi) verified AOT-clean. SDK pinned to 10.0.x.

nodes.label: Helm NOTES.txt
nodes.summary: Kubernetes deployment post-install notes template showing API/migrator images, PostgreSQL/Redis configuration, Kong gateway access, and helm test verification.

nodes.label: Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Living document tracking 6 phases (baseline through deployment) with 136 tests, AOT smoke testing, and follow-up items (CI workflow, multi-RID, xunit v3 migration, auth).

nodes.label: Java Feature Gap
nodes.summary: Comprehensive feature matrix comparing Spring Boot Java reference (Spring Boot 4.1.1, Postgres + Flyway, Redis) to .NET implementation. Covers all capabilities: subscriptions, plans, invoices, search, caching, health, OpenAPI, Docker, tests. Notes 8 deviations from Java reference.

nodes.label: Native AOT Assessment
nodes.summary: Pre-implementation AOT assessment with 5 risk items. Verified result: zero AOT warnings on publish of both API and Migrator. All 5 risk items (Npgsql, Redis, OpenTelemetry, OpenApi/Scalar, ProblemDetails) work without warnings.

nodes.label: Performance Data
nodes.summary: Performance benchmarks comparing .NET 8 (not available), original JIT, new JIT, and Native AOT on startup, RSS, image size, latency, and throughput. AOT shows ~5x faster startup, ~2x lower memory, 61 MB container image.

nodes.label: Technical Design
nodes.summary: Technical design document covering architecture evolution from 3-endpoint EF Core sample to full-featured vertical slice API with PostgreSQL, Redis, explicit SQL stores, OpenTelemetry, health checks, and Native AOT constraints.
